defaults.negative_prompt: dialogue, voices, narration, people talking, on-screen text, captions, watermark, logos, fast motion, camera shake, metal hardware, zippers, buckles, morphing

scenes.prompt: Very slow rack focus from the white stitching to the woven straw below, the fingertips rest still on the leather, the bag keeps its exact construction. The leather flap stays ONE single seamless sheet folded all the way over, lying completely flat the entire clip: no gap, seam, or split ever opens anywhere in it, nothing behind it ever shows through it, and its cut edge shapes never separate into pieces.
